scope: A single-file book-of-business tracker and its companion onboarding guide, bundled and validated together as one release. Both run from file:// with no build step and no server. The tracker holds its book in browser localStorage under obm-data-v1; the guide holds its own progress under separate osm-guide-* keys and never reads or writes the tracker's book. The AI Copilot features are the only ones requiring a network connection and an Anthropic API key.
guideCoverage: The guide covers the tracker through 1.0 with one known gap: its First Value narrative still teaches the pre-Phase-B earliest-linked-evidence model and does not yet cover the deliverable-checkbox evidence capture, the customer-demonstrated/we-observed attribution control, or First Value's derived path — updating it is outstanding. See VALIDATION.txt, WHAT WAS NOT VERIFIED. Everything it does cover is taught with its limits, not only its benefit: the Gainsight sync queue has no transport, impact minutes are an editable assumption, signal calibration needs four resolutions, the Progress Report is a snapshot, and automatic backup costs one click per session rather than being unattended.
openItems: The Handoff field set is PROVISIONAL - a product open question, not a documentation gap.
The Gainsight sync queue stages items but has no transport.
Impact minutes are an editable assumption rather than a measurement.
Signal calibration requires four resolutions before it carries weight.
Automatic backup requires one user gesture per browser session.
